neutralDescription.en: Crossing Verte Bridge into the Bose region (no return to Rolent)
neutralDescription.pt: Atravessar a Verte Bridge para a região de Bose (sem volta para Rolent)

neutralDescription.en: Passing the soldiers on East Bose Highway into Eisen Road
neutralDescription.pt: Passar pelos soldados na East Bose Highway rumo à Eisen Road

neutralDescription.en: Heading to Ravennue Village to follow the airliner lead
neutralDescription.pt: Ir para Ravennue Village atrás da pista do airliner

neutralDescription.en: The clearing in the Abandoned Mine (boss fight)
neutralDescription.pt: A clareira da Abandoned Mine (luta contra chefe)

neutralDescription.en: Talking to Sophina at the Kingfisher Inn (stuck at Valleria Shore)
neutralDescription.pt: Falar com a Sophina na Kingfisher Inn (preso em Valleria Shore)

neutralDescription.en: Leaving the Sky Pirate Stronghold (end of Chapter 1)
neutralDescription.pt: Sair do Sky Pirate Stronghold (fim do Capítulo 1)

location.pt: Capela de Rolent e depois capela de Bose

hint.en: 2 BP. Short deadline. Pick up the letter from Father Divine BEFORE crossing Verte Bridge, then give it to Father Holstein in the Bose chapel.
hint.pt: 2 BP. Prazo curto. Pegue a carta com o Father Divine ANTES de atravessar a Verte Bridge e entregue ao Father Holstein na capela de Bose.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Bose

hint.en: 2 (+2) BP. Not on the board, new in the remake. At Perzel Farm check every green marker; pick the 1st option at the strawberries and the 2nd at the cow for the bonus. Eat the Sunshine Mille Crepe for its recipe.
hint.pt: 2 (+2) BP. Não aparece no quadro, nova no remake. Na Perzel Farm, examine todos os marcadores verdes; escolha a 1ª opção nos morangos e a 2ª na vaca para o bônus. Coma o Sunshine Mille Crepe para aprender a receita.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Bose

hint.en: 4 BP. Short deadline. Its Fate Saber can K.O. instantly: bring Deathblow protection (Grail Ring, Crest Charm). It is slow and easy to stun.
hint.pt: 4 BP. Prazo curto. O Fate Saber dele pode derrubar na hora: leve proteção contra Deathblow (Grail Ring, Crest Charm). Ele é lento e fácil de atordoar.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Bose

hint.en: 3 BP. Bring 5 Monster Tenders, dropped by Limera and Hresvelgr (start of Eisen Road, or the hidden cave on West Bose Highway). Rewards the Royal Omelette recipe.
hint.pt: 3 BP. Leve 5 Monster Tenders, que caem de Limera e Hresvelgr (início da Eisen Road ou a caverna escondida da West Bose Highway). Dá a receita do Royal Omelette.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Bose

hint.en: 4 BP. Not on the board: it starts when you enter Amberl Tower. Reach 5F, approach the center, then leave the tower.
hint.pt: 4 BP. Não aparece no quadro: começa quando você entra na Amberl Tower. Suba até o 5F, aproxime-se do centro e depois saia da torre.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Haken Gate

hint.en: 4 BP. Appears after Divine Delivery. Bring two Bear Claws from Nebel Valley: near the end of the west path (after its quest monster) and beside the Thelas Balm chest.
hint.pt: 4 BP. Aparece depois da Divine Delivery. Leve duas Bear Claws de Nebel Valley: perto do fim do caminho oeste (depois do monstro da quest) e ao lado do baú do Thelas Balm.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Haken Gate

hint.en: 4 (+1) BP. Walk Hart to Krone Trail; if he falls it's game over, so avoid fights. Choose "A frontal assault!" (1st option) for the bonus.
hint.pt: 4 (+1) BP. Leve o Hart até a Krone Trail; se ele cair é game over, então evite lutas. Escolha "A frontal assault!" (1ª opção) para o bônus.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Haken Gate

hint.en: 4 BP. Poisonous scorpions; the leader calls more.
hint.pt: 4 BP. Escorpiões venenosos; o líder chama mais.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Haken Gate

hint.en: 5 BP. Kill the Boiled Eggers from a distance (they explode) and wear Flame Zippos against Freeze.
hint.pt: 5 BP. Derrube os Boiled Eggers à distância (eles explodem) e use Flame Zippos contra Freeze.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Haken Gate

hint.en: 4 BP. The toughest of this set: spread out, keep Earth Guard up and protect against Mute, Seal and Blind.
hint.pt: 4 BP. O mais difícil deste grupo: espalhe a equipe, mantenha o Earth Guard e se proteja de Mute, Seal e Blind.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Haken Gate

hint.en: 4 BP. New in the remake. Help Anelace in Nebel Valley; Flame Zippos recommended. Later, Sting at the Bose guild gives Proxy Puppet S ×2.
hint.pt: 4 BP. Nova no remake. Ajude a Anelace em Nebel Valley; Flame Zippos recomendados. Depois, o Sting na guilda de Bose dá Proxy Puppet S ×2.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Valleria Shore

hint.en: 5 BP. It blocks the way to Valleria Shore, so you can't skip it. The turtles shrug off physical hits: use arts and step out of the red circles.
hint.pt: 5 BP. Ele bloqueia o caminho para Valleria Shore, então não dá para pular. As tartarugas aguentam golpes físicos: use arts e saia dos círculos vermelhos.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Valleria Shore

name.en: Bonus BP: the answer on the airliner deck
name.pt: BP bônus: a resposta no convés do airliner

hint.en: +3 BP (Missing Airliner). Outside on the airliner, pick the 5th option: their hideout is somewhere special.
hint.pt: +3 BP (Missing Airliner). No lado de fora do airliner, escolha a 5ª opção: o esconderijo deles fica num lugar especial.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Haken Gate

location.en: Sky Pirate Stronghold — second floor, northwest
location.pt: Sky Pirate Stronghold — segundo andar, noroeste

hint.en: Examining it gives the Black Notebook, needed for the hidden quest Black Notebook in Chapter 2.
hint.pt: Examiná-lo dá o Black Notebook, necessário para a quest escondida Black Notebook no Capítulo 2.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Valleria Shore

hint.en: He stands by the gate: talk to him before going through.
hint.pt: Ele fica junto ao portão: fale com ele antes de passar.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Bose

hint.en: Buy it before leaving Rolent.
hint.pt: Compre antes de sair de Rolent.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Bose

location.en: Haken Gate — Marco in the rest area
location.pt: Haken Gate — Marco na área de descanso

hint.en: Talk to him before entering the main building and examining the far door.
hint.pt: Fale com ele antes de entrar no prédio principal e examinar a porta do fundo.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Haken Gate

hint.en: Talk to him before heading to Valleria Shore. Grocery Minuet sells missed volumes, at a high price.
hint.pt: Fale com ele antes de ir para Valleria Shore. A Grocery Minuet vende volumes perdidos, por um preço alto.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Valleria Shore

hint.en: Buy it before leaving the Bose region.
hint.pt: Compre antes de sair da região de Bose.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Valleria Shore

name.en: Hundred Days War - A True Account

hint.en: Received in a story scene: you can't miss it.
hint.pt: Recebido numa cena da história: não tem como perder.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Valleria Shore

hint.en: Eat each dish once to learn its recipe.
hint.pt: Coma cada prato uma vez para aprender a receita.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Bose
guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Haken Gate

text.en: Sunshine Mille Crepe — Elissa's Entreaty reward (Rolent)
text.pt: Sunshine Mille Crepe — recompensa da Elissa's Entreaty (Rolent)

text.en: Sweet Castella — Caterina's Shop, Bose Market
text.pt: Sweet Castella — Caterina's Shop, Bose Market

text.en: Flowery Jelly — Caterina's Shop, Bose Market
text.pt: Flowery Jelly — Caterina's Shop, Bose Market

text.en: Beast Steak — chest on Ravennue Trail
text.pt: Beast Steak — baú na Ravennue Trail
Royal Omelette — recompensa da Culinary Collection

text.en: Cursed Fried Eyeballs — chest on Krone Trail
text.pt: Cursed Fried Eyeballs — baú na Krone Trail

text.en: Heaven-and-Hell Stew — have some stew at Whemler Hut (2nd option)
text.pt: Heaven-and-Hell Stew — aceite o ensopado na Whemler Hut (2ª opção)

text.en: Grilled Rockfish Skewer — The Kingfisher Inn
text.pt: Grilled Rockfish Skewer — The Kingfisher Inn

text.en: Grilled Rainbow Trout — The Kingfisher Inn
text.pt: Grilled Rainbow Trout — The Kingfisher Inn

text.en: Apple Ice Cream — The Moonlight Path, Ravennue Village
text.pt: Apple Ice Cream — The Moonlight Path, Ravennue Village

text.en: Fresh-Squeezed Juice — The Moonlight Path, Ravennue Village
text.pt: Fresh-Squeezed Juice — The Moonlight Path, Ravennue Village

hint.en: Two of the three can be opened before the story event midway along the road.
hint.pt: Dois dos três podem ser abertos antes do evento da história no meio da estrada.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Bose

hint.en: The monster chest holds Katars, an upgrade for Joshua. A hidden cave in the southwest is a farming spot.
hint.pt: O baú de monstros tem Katars, uma melhoria para o Joshua. Uma caverna escondida no sudoeste serve para farmar.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Bose

text.en: Katars (monster chest: Rock Pecker+ ×3, Rock Pecker ×3)
text.pt: Katars (baú de monstros: Rock Pecker+ ×3, Rock Pecker ×3)

hint.en: Four chests before the quest marker (approaching it starts the boss fight), three after it.
hint.pt: Quatro baús antes do marcador da quest (chegar perto começa a luta), três depois.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Bose

text.pt: Strega R (baú de monstros: Millipede Ball+ ×2)

name.pt: Baús de Krone Trail (lado de Bose) (3)

hint.en: Includes the Cursed Fried Eyeballs dish. Reach the western checkpoint to unlock fast travel.
hint.pt: Inclui o prato Cursed Fried Eyeballs. Chegue ao posto a oeste para liberar a viagem rápida.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Bose

hint.en: Many enemies freeze: wear Flame Zippos. Picking up a Bear Claw early skips a fun line in a later quest.
hint.pt: Muitos inimigos congelam: use Flame Zippos. Pegar uma Bear Claw cedo pula uma fala divertida de uma quest futura.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Bose

hint.en: Evasive enemies: Hit quartz on the field leader helps.
hint.pt: Inimigos evasivos: quartzo Hit no líder de campo ajuda.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Bose

hint.en: Both monster chests hold Ground Trappers that explode on defeat; they are very weak to wind (Aero Storm).
hint.pt: Os dois baús de monstros têm Ground Trappers que explodem ao serem derrotados; eles são muito fracos contra vento (Aero Storm).

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Bose

text.pt: 4F — Yellow Sphere (baú de monstros: Ground Trapper ×3)
4F — Chain Mail (baú de monstros: Ground Trapper ×3)

hint.en: Limera reflect arts and call Hresvelgr; both drop the Monster Tenders for Culinary Collection.
hint.pt: Limeras refletem arts e chamam Hresvelgr; os dois deixam cair os Monster Tenders da Culinary Collection.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Haken Gate

hint.en: One-time visit. Take the right path for both chests before heading toward the story event.
hint.pt: Visita única. Pegue o caminho da direita para os dois baús antes de ir ao evento da história.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Haken Gate

hint.en: One-time dungeon. The last chest holds the Jeweled Ring for the Ring Robbery quest, and the vacuum cleaner on the second floor starts a hidden quest.
hint.pt: Dungeon de visita única. O último baú tem o Jeweled Ring da quest Ring Robbery, e o aspirador de pó do segundo andar começa uma quest escondida.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Valleria Shore

strategy.en: Its Fate Saber can K.O. instantly: wear Deathblow protection or keep revives ready. It is slow, so delay and Overdrive can lock it down.
strategy.pt: O Fate Saber pode derrubar na hora: use proteção contra Deathblow ou deixe itens de reviver prontos. Ele é lento, então atraso e Overdrive podem travá-lo.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Bose

strategy.en: Easy: poisonous scorpions and more of them over time.
strategy.pt: Fácil: escorpiões venenosos, e mais deles com o tempo.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Haken Gate

strategy.en: Kill the Boiled Eggers from range (they explode), wear Flame Zippos against Diamond Dust's Freeze, and dispel its Rage near the end.
strategy.pt: Derrube os Boiled Eggers à distância (eles explodem), use Flame Zippos contra o Freeze do Diamond Dust e remova o Rage dele perto do fim.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Haken Gate

strategy.en: Fast and tanky. Spread out against its area attacks, keep Earth Guard up, protect against Mute, Seal and Blind, and Sever its Rage.
strategy.pt: Rápido e resistente. Espalhe a equipe contra os ataques em área, mantenha o Earth Guard, se proteja de Mute, Seal e Blind e use o Sever no Rage.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Haken Gate

name.pt: Kyle e os piratas do céu

strategy.en: Grenades hit in small areas: spread out and cast Earth Guard. Clear the three pirates first; Kyle is tanky and can Burn or Blind.
strategy.pt: As granadas acertam pequenas áreas: espalhe a equipe e use Earth Guard. Derrube os três piratas primeiro; o Kyle é resistente e pode causar Burn ou Blind.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Haken Gate

strategy.en: Wear Flame Zippos against its Ice Breath and dispel its Rage with Sever or Anti-Sept. Sylphen Wing helps.
strategy.pt: Use Flame Zippos contra o Ice Breath e remova o Rage com Sever ou Anti-Sept. Sylphen Wing ajuda.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Valleria Shore

strategy.en: Very high physical defense: use arts and magic crafts, and step out of the red circles. At low HP it reflects one art.
strategy.pt: Defesa física altíssima: use arts e crafts mágicos e saia dos círculos vermelhos. Com pouco HP, reflete uma art.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Valleria Shore

strategy.en: Harder than the Prologue boss and you can't go back to town: bring La Tear, Earth Guard and Clock Up EX. Focus one sibling at a time near 33% HP so they don't Rage together, and leave the tanky Don for last.
strategy.pt: Mais difícil que o chefe do Prólogo e não dá para voltar à cidade: leve La Tear, Earth Guard e Clock Up EX. Foque um irmão por vez perto de 33% do HP para que não entrem em Rage juntos, e deixe o Don, mais resistente, por último.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Chapter 1 - Valleria Shore
